value.per: 10-year extension, naming rights and team sponsorship combined

source.name: Levi Strauss & Co. - LS&Co. Extends Levi's Stadium Naming Rights and 49ers Partnership
source.quote: announced the proposal for a 10-year extension to the naming rights for Levi’s® Stadium and team sponsorship, worth a combined $170 million

note: Stadium naming rights: Levi's Stadium. LS&Co. secured the naming rights in 2013; the January 2024 proposal extends them through the 2043 NFL season. The $170 million is the reported value of the 10-year extension (naming rights plus team sponsorship combined), not of the whole 2013-2043 relationship.
